---
title: Group Members Into Specific Segments
description: >-
  Group your members by creating static or dynamic lists and using condition
  rules to filter audiences based on specific customer behaviors.
---
<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="1378" height="761" />

## Step

1. Navigate to Members > Segments. Enter group name, description, and choose between a Static list or a Dynamic that updates automatically based on member behavior.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="250" height="297" style="width: 250px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="679" height="259" style="width: 679px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

2. Use the condition tool to filter members by specific rules.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="494" height="247" style="width: 494px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

3. Review the generated list at the bottom to see exactly which customers fit your criteria.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="611" height="198" style="width: 611px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />
